svg.title: Night Water Academy 夜水书院 — illustration
svg.desc: A taped game-screen window on a dotted journal page: a Chinese academy hall with upturned eaves stands over calm moonlit water at a pastel dusk, with its soft reflection, floating lanterns, a crescent moon and gentle rain. Beside it: a game controller doodle, two puzzle pieces and PRESS START in pixel caps; the small robot-cat peeks out from behind the screen under a clear umbrella. Stamped 検証済.
